sections.title: Disease Summary Table
points: Polio: Caused by a Virus in contaminated water. Causes paralysis/lameness.
Rickets: Caused by lack of Vitamin D/Calcium. Causes bowlegs/knock-knees.
TB of Spine: Caused by Mycobacterium bacteria. Causes backache and a lump on the spine.
Tetanus: Caused by soil bacteria entering cuts. Causes stiff muscles (Lockjaw).
Leprosy: Caused by bacteria spread by direct contact. Causes loss of feeling in skin.

sections.title: Prevention & Control
points: Polio: Boil drinking water and use latrines properly.
TB: Drink pasteurized/boiled milk (to kill bacteria from infected cows).
Leprosy: Avoid sharing towels/beddings with infected people.

sections.text: Osteoporosis is common in women after menopause; it causes thinning of bones, making them brittle and easy to break!
